profile_name: Thomas Family Trust (landlord; statement issued as Propwest Investments (Pty) Ltd) - rental invoices
_doc: Thomas Family Trust folder: 9 one-page Sage-style Tax Invoices (Account No, Invoice Date, Invoice Number INVPR..., one line 'RENTAL FOR <month>' with VAT and line total, Subtotal (Exclusive), Vat, Total) that print NO biller name or VAT number in the text layer, and 1 Statement issued as Propwest Investments (Pty) Ltd with its VAT number. These are RENTAL invoices, not utility bills: no electricity or water is billed, so no electricity row is produced; the rental line lands in a 'sundry' row (desc, VAT, line total ex VAT, Subtotal (Exclusive)) and the statement yields no row. Fingerprint: the INVPR invoice-number prefix (the only biller-specific marker the invoices carry) plus any of the Propwest name / its VAT number / the invoice layout word 'VatAmnt'. No identity applicable (no electricity). Checked on 10/10.
